name: Artzosuchus
isnote: Placed in the Artzosuchidae by PBDB; Wikipedia says its classification beyond basal crocodylomorph is indeterminate.
sum: Artzosuchus is a basal crocodylomorph known from the Campanian Djadokhta Formation of Mongolia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens from the Üüden Sair locality, Djadokhta Formation, Mongolia.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Efimov 1983

sources.text: M. B. Efimov. 1983. Obzor iskopayemykh krokodilov Mongolii [Overview of the fossil crocodiles of Mongolia]. Fossil Reptiles of Mongolia.
